_purpose: Map customer segments to opex_data.json::by_sbu SBU names. Used by utils.pbt_computation.compute_pbt_by_sbu to attribute customer-facing income to SBUs. Per Rule N1, admin-editable to accommodate tenant terminology (Mass/Personal/Standard, SME/Small/Medium etc.).
_three_naming_conventions_unified_here: The codebase has three concurrent segment naming conventions: (1) segment_config.json _locked_codes for production (AFFLUENT/CORE_MIDDLE/MASS/MICRO/SMALL/MEDIUM/CORPORATE); (2) VirtualBankCore.SegmentType for dev/seed (RETAIL/HNW/PRIVATE_BANKING/SME/CORPORATE); (3) opex_data.json by_sbu names (Retail Banking/Commercial Banking/Corporate Banking/Treasury/Digital/Agency). This file maps any of (1) or (2) to (3) so compute_pbt_by_sbu can aggregate correctly.

_documentation.segment_to_sbu: Direct lookup. Each customer's segment code maps to exactly one SBU. Customers with unknown segments fall into 'Unallocated' bucket.
_documentation.operational_sbus: SBUs that exist in opex_data.json::by_sbu but have no customer-attributable accounts (Treasury for interbank/FX, Digital/Agency for channel operations). Their PBT = -OpEx until production GL provides treasury revenue. Listed here so compute_pbt_by_sbu knows to create entries for them even though no customers map to them.
